text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle was in the dance studio.
She 
seemed to be brooding over something...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hhhmmm...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Think I'll just head home today after 
all.
choice_data_list: Wait, wait! Aren't we supposed to ...
Wait, wait! Aren't we supposed to ...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Wait, wait! Weren't you going to p...
Wait, wait! Aren't we supposed to ...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~ well, no, that was the plan, 
but~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Once I got here and changed into my gym 
clothes, I kinda just lost all my 
motivation...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's just solo practice anyway...
it's not 
like it's strictly mandatory,
right? ...Or 
so I thought.
choice_data_list: Still, you thought practice was ne...
Still, you thought practice was ne...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, yes. If I'm standing on stage, I 
don't want to show everyone a clumsy 
dance...
choice_data_list: Still, you thought practice was ne...
Still, you thought practice was ne...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I came here ready to do my 
best, but...

It seems she's caught a rare case of 
"wanting to slack off." Still,
we came all 
this way. I really want her to get her 
motivation back...!
choice_data_list: Just taking action at all is impre...

text_block_list.text:
Exactly!
The very moment you decided to do 
extra practice, you already took a step 
forward!!
choice_data_list: Taking action in the first place i...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"I heard everything!
I bet you're just not 
motivated 'cause you're all alone!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, I can join you! Let's 
practice together!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: B-Bamboo-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
U-Ummm... Well then, let's reschedule for 
tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"We're going at it tomorrow too, right?! 
Understood! In that case, I won't push 
myself too hard today!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah............ Yeah, pretty much~.
choice_data_list: Oh, you're really motivated!
Oh, you're full of motivation!
Watch your pacing, you hear?
Be careful with your pacing, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah............ Yeah, pretty much~.
choice_data_list: Whoa, you're really fired up!
Whoa, you're super motivated!
Watch your pacing, alright?
Be careful with your pacing, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Well, now that it's come to this, 
I'll do it!
choice_data_list: Whoa, you're really fired up!
Whoa, you're super motivated!
Watch your pacing, alright?
Be careful with your pacing, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go all out and build up my 
confidence, you'll see!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You're really fired up! Now I'm getting 
pumped too!!

Afterward,
practically being dragged along 
by Bamboo Memory,
Hishi Miracle managed to 
get through her dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Defeats the whole point if extra 
practice leaves me wiped out for
tomorrow, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, are we really doing this again 
tomorrow~?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course... Wait,
weren't you the one who 
brought it up, Mirako?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I guess it depends on my mood 
tomorrow. For now, I'll do it properly 
today! Bamboo-chan is here with me, after 
all!

Thanks in part to Bamboo Memory's help, 
Hishi Miracle managed to get through her 
dance lessons properly.
